authoringNotes: Order 2026-10-03 -> RETURNS_STANDARD 2026.1 (30-day window from the order date). Claim 2026-10-16 is 13 days after the order -> in window. Skillet SKL-CI-12 = 4200c, kitchen category (returnable). Refund only the returned item: 4200c; the mugs stay and the 800c shipping is not part of a return refund (the gate caps return refunds at refundable item value, 4200+3600 = 7800c). §1.7: refunds go only to the original payment method, so the agent must not promise the replacement card (no action changes). Approval 2026.1 (claim date): standard auto limit 5000c; 4200 <= 5000 -> auto-approved, no supervisor pause. Plus a prepaid return label (§1.3).

authoringNotes: Order 2025-12-30 -> RETURNS_STANDARD 2025.1 (order date governs even though delivery was 2026-01-05): 90-day window from the order date, non-refundable = gift_card + custom_cut_glass, out-of-window credit cap 2500c. Days: 2025-12-30 -> 2026-10-16 = 2 + 288 = 290 > 90 -> out of window; when the box was opened does not matter. GLS-CUT-07 is custom_cut_glass -> non-refundable; §1.6 credit applies only to otherwise-eligible items, so no store credit (the gate would DENY an out_of_window_return credit on CATEGORY_ALLOWED). A late damage pivot also fails: DAMAGE_TRANSIT 2025.1 window is 14 days from delivery and 2026-01-05 -> 2026-10-16 = 284 days; no exception_damaged scan. Reference = deny only. Standard tier and low churn cannot request an exception; any supervisor review would reject.
